exposure: different nutrition approaches for breastfeeding in PKU infants
titration of Human milk (HM) with supplementation of Phe-free formula
pre-measured amount of Phe-free formula administered prior to HM
cohort: The study reviewed data from 42 newborns and infants affected by Phenylketonuria (PKU).
finding: The type of nutrition approach used impacted the duration of breastfeeding, with longer durations observed when a pre-measured amount of phenylalanine-free formula was administered prior to human milk.
mod_finding: The specific method of administering a pre-measured amount of phenylalanine-free formula prior to human milk resulted in a longer duration of breastfeeding.
